title: TorchBorn
description: Something Comes Out Of Fire.. New Tools! New Armors! New Ore`s! New Block!
body:
Forged in eternal flame, TorchBorn weapons and armor glow with the fury of living fire. Each blade ignites with every strike, each armor piece radiates untamed heat. This set is not just gear — it's a warning. Wielded only by those brave enough to burn brighter than the darkness itself.



This is a fully original mod created by me.
Redistribution, modification, or commercial use is strictly prohibited.
You are allowed to showcase the mod on social media platforms (YouTube, TikTok, etc.) only if the download link used is the official one I provide.
